title: AtpEmitRequest
description: The protocol-visible emit handshake: one typed event about one canonical entity. The two-argument floor (event + entity) is mandatory; free-form prose is not admissible (ATP-0001 §3, §12.4). This is the logical contract, not a wire message — the wire artifact is the ATP-0001 batch.

protocol_version.description: ATP wire version. v0.1 is exactly 0x0001.

schema_id.description: Content-addressed schema identity H_S = SHA-256(D_MANIFEST || CanonicalCBOR(manifest)), lowercase hex.

primitive.description: ATP primitive fixed by the annotation kind. StateCheckpoint (3) is SDK-emitted, never app-authored.

entity.description: Canonical entity identity, namespace:resource_type:canonical_identifier (ATP-0001 §4.1). Required unless bound once via forEntity(...).

fields.description: Typed field values keyed by their record slot index (dense 0..k-1). Each value is a typed scalar per the resolved schema; absent optional slots are omitted.

event_time_unix_ms.description: Optional caller-supplied event time; default is call time. The SDK derives the batch-relative time_delta (ATP-0001 §6.1).
